description: Defines an abstract class Zend_XmlRpc_Value for representing and manipulating XML-RPC values, including factory methods for creating specific value objects based on PHP variables or XML strings. This file is central to how the Zend Framework handles XML-RPC data.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value
classes.description: An abstract class that represents a native XML-RPC value, providing methods for creating value objects from PHP variables or XML, and for retrieving the value in various formats.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the native XML-RPC type of the value object.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Returns the XML generator instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Changes the encoding of the generator.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the PHP representation of the value.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the value, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: generateXml
methods.description: Generates the XML code for the value.

methods.name: getXmlRpcValue
methods.description: Factory method to create a Zend_XmlRpc_Value object based on a PHP variable, XML string, or explicit type.

methods.name: getXmlRpcTypeByValue
methods.description: Determines the XML-RPC type for a given PHP value.

methods.name: _phpVarToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Converts a PHP variable into the appropriate Zend_XmlRpc_Value object.

methods.name: _xmlStringToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Parses an XML string to produce the corresponding Zend_XmlRpc_Value object.

methods.name: _createSimpleXMLElement
methods.description: Creates a SimpleXMLElement object from an XML string if necessary.

methods.name: _extractTypeAndValue
methods.description: Extracts the type and value from a SimpleXMLElement representing an XML-RPC value.

methods.name: _setXML
methods.description: Sets the internal XML representation, stripping the declaration.
